user_id.description: Authorizer user ID. Must be a valid hex string.

user_details.description: List of user entries to add or remove. Maximum 50 entries per request.

user_details[].user_id.description: User ID. Primary identifier. Required if username is omitted. Takes precedence if both are provided.

user_details[].username.description: Username. Required if user_id is omitted.

user_details[].action.description: Operation to perform. ADD shares access to the hub, REMOVE revokes access to the hub.
